## Summary
Encodes, decodes, and rewrites the WebRTC absolute capture time RTP header extension. The package owns the extension URI, validation errors, NTP timestamp storage, optional capture clock offset handling, and binary wire serialization.

## Responsibilities
- Define the absolute capture time RTP header extension URI.
- Store absolute capture timestamps and optional estimated capture clock offsets.
- Rewrite capture timestamps by a time offset.
- Marshal and unmarshal shortened and extended absolute capture time payloads.
